suggestion.to: From 2014 to 2019, under contract to JPL, our Centre for Electronic Imaging (CEI) characterised, designed and tested the EM-CCD sensor for Roman’s coronagraph, leading to the CCD311 chosen for flight: a radiation-hardened version of the CCD201. We continue to refine the ‘trap-pumping’ techniques we developed for Euclid to counter radiation damage to these sensors.
